name: staphylococcal nuclease and tudor domain containing 1

function.text: SND1 encodes staphylococcal nuclease domain-containing protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and endonuclease activity. It participates in osteoblast differentiation and mRNA catabolic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
